name: Mercenary Shatter
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Shatter (players/sorcerer/mercenary/shatter_merc.sval, 20 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 2 (in brackets): 20% on any kill (100% on frozen kills). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Any enemy you kill, frozen or not, has a 20% chance to burst for 80 hybrid damage to enemies near it.
